$comment: Declarations in this package's blocks that are not layout on tokens, each with the kit gap it waits for. A row whose selector no longer exists in its file is stale and is removed with the change that removes the selector.

rows.gap: The kit has no width token for a reading measure.
The kit's Skeleton has no shape axis (title, line, circle) and the kit has no width token, so the block sizes the title placeholder.
The kit has no plain list part; the swatches are a real list with the user agent's markers and indent reset.
The kit has no colour swatch component; a Card or Item paints its own surface, which a swatch must replace with the token it shows.
The kit candidate Text sets a colour of its own, which a token-painted surface cannot take; the swatch types its name itself.
As for .name: the token pair caption takes the mono role without the candidate's colour.
The kit has no colour swatch component (ColorSwatch, kit candidate P7 not proposed); painting the pair is the swatch's content.
